method: Fetched and inspected source text for each finite set, checked canonical names or accepted aliases against it, reviewed stated boundaries and historical cutoffs. Name presence is a supporting structural signal, not an independent proof of every claim. No copyrighted page bodies are committed.

Added Grana Padano as an accepted traditional pesto cheese alternative.
Replaced a repetitive compass-direction answer set with mahjong tile categories.
